name: Horizon3.ai NodeZero
what_it_does: Autonomous penetration-testing platform that orchestrates real attacker tradecraft across enterprise IT infrastructure. AI-augmented decision making within the platform; valuable for the broader attack-surface context within which AI systems sit (an LLM agent's blast radius depends on the network and identity it can reach).
what_it_doesnt_do: It is not primarily an AI-content red-team tool — it does not focus on prompt injection or model evaluation. Pair with PyRIT/Promptfoo/etc. for AI-specific testing. As with any autonomous pentest, scoping discipline and explicit authorization are essential.
best_for: Regulated enterprises validating end-to-end blast radius around AI-enabled infrastructure
